summary: treemap leaf has a value of 0
help: Give the leaf a positive value, or remove it.
rationale: A zero value sizes the rectangle to zero area, so the declared leaf never appears in the drawing.

summary: treemap has no row carrying a value
help: Give at least one leaf row a value.
rationale: Rectangle areas come from leaf values, so a tree with no valued leaf renders empty.

summary: two treemap rows under one parent share a label
help: Rename one of the rows, or merge them.
rationale: Two identically labeled siblings render as two boxes a reader cannot tell apart.

summary: treemap row has a value and indented child rows
help: Move the value to a leaf row, or remove the indented rows.
rationale: Mermaid treats a valued row as a leaf and re-parents the rows under it, so the drawn hierarchy differs from the written one.
